gaps.explanation: Statement p4 (Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances (Deficit) - Modified Cash Basis - Governmental Funds) prints major fund columns General, Street, Park, Sales Tax that have no schedule of their own; detail[] holds only the nonmajor combining schedule p10 (= p4 Other Governmental Funds column, total revenues 63,403 = schedule_total). Missing p4 column totals: General 536,525 (355,905 + 131,535 + 178 + 7,585 + 41,322) + Street 290,222 (1,172 + 283,965 + 5,085) + Park 77,047 (74,049 + 5 + 2,993) + Sales Tax 209,670 (209,474 + 196) = 1,113,464 = gap. Check: 63,403 + 1,113,464 = 1,176,867 = p4 Total Governmental Funds revenues. The 14 revenue lines below fix it. ALSO added here (section 'other financing', NOT part of the revenue arithmetic; no transfers gap row exists because the Total column eliminates transfers): the same four columns' printed other financing rows on p4 - General Transfers in 98,762 and Transfers out (17,478), Street Bond and loan proceeds 405,000 and Transfers out (1,861), Sales Tax Transfers out (65,000). With the nonmajor transfers already in detail (+1,877, -11,400, -4,900 = -14,423), transfers in 98,762 = transfers out 17,478 + 1,861 + 65,000 + 14,423 (the p4 Eliminations column).

gaps.explanation: The report prints two different proprietary statements. Statement lines use the basic statement p6 (report p11): Charges for service Totals 557,296 (Water 305,176) + interest income 2,093 = 559,389. Detail uses the supplementary statement p11 (report p37): Charges for service Totals 571,830 (Water 319,710) + interest 2,093 = 573,923 (Garbage 154,218 + Water 320,922 + Sewer 98,783). Difference = Water charges 319,710 - 305,176 = 14,534 = gap (-14,534). Both are printed amounts (already in report_discrepancies); no missing or duplicate lines.

Same two printed proprietary statements: p6 (report p11) total operating expenses 469,966 (Water sales taxes 11,470) + interest expense 12,587 = 482,553; p11 (report p37) total operating expenses 468,951 (Water sales taxes 10,455) + interest expense 12,587 = 481,538. Difference = sales taxes 11,470 - 10,455 = 1,015 = gap. Printed figures differ within the report; no fix.
